source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: China International Fair for Trade in Services opens in Beijing today
topics.why_hot: The fair is a major annual event for global trade in services, and its opening is a top economy-and-policy topic on Chinese social media.
topics.share_angle: Use it to explain what CIFTIS is, why services trade matters to China and other economies, and what industries are being showcased.

topics.chinese_topic: 香港首任特首董建华逝世
topics.official_english: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, passes away
topics.why_hot: Tung Chee-hwa was a historic figure as the first chief executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, so his death dominates news feeds.
topics.share_angle: Recount his role in Hong Kong's early years after the handover and note the broad reactions without speculating on private details.

topics.chinese_topic: 华为小米抢先苹果把折叠屏卖到2万元
topics.official_english: Huawei and Xiaomi race ahead of Apple with foldable phones priced around 20,000 yuan
topics.why_hot: Foldable phones are a visible premium smartphone battleground, and Chinese brands pricing them near 20,000 yuan before Apple sparks a wide tech debate.
topics.share_angle: Compare the foldable strategies of Huawei, Xiaomi and Apple, and explain why premium pricing and hardware design matter in the Chinese market.

topics.chinese_topic: 航天员在太空烤上了小蛋糕
topics.official_english: Chinese astronauts bake small cakes in space
topics.why_hot: Space life videos are always popular, and seeing astronauts bake small cakes adds a warm, human angle to orbital science.
topics.share_angle: Explain how baking works in microgravity and why food experiments matter for long-duration space missions.

topics.chinese_topic: 郑钦文父亲：这个时候的她最可怕
topics.official_english: Zheng Qinwen's father says she is most formidable at this moment
topics.why_hot: Zheng Qinwen is one of the most followed Chinese athletes, so her father's comment about her mental edge quickly becomes a sports conversation online.
topics.share_angle: Use the quote to discuss what top-level tennis demands mentally and why Chinese fans track Zheng Qinwen's form closely.

topics.why_hot: Haidilao is a well-known hotpot brand, and a sudden sharp drop attracts attention from both investors and consumers.
topics.share_angle: Explain what this market move means for the company and what it might or might not say about Chinese consumer sentiment.

topics.official_english: Are fuel-powered cars really not selling?
topics.why_hot: With China's rapid shift toward electric vehicles, many internet users now question the future of traditional gasoline cars.
topics.share_angle: Use this trending question to explain the fuel-to-EV transition in China's auto market and the choices buyers face.

topics.chinese_topic: 高考数学132分 开学考只考了12分
topics.official_english: Student scores 132 in gaokao math but only 12 in back-to-school test
topics.why_hot: The huge gap between an excellent gaokao math score and a very low opening-school test score touches off debate about exams, study habits and learning pressure.
topics.share_angle: Explain the Chinese context of gaokao and back-to-school tests, then explore why such score gaps trigger anxiety among parents and students.
